subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for all Claude CLI prompt-drift false invalidations, or should the remaining live-session restart work move to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81041 after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91157 is resolved?
rationale: Current main fixed much of the binding-reset class, but discussion has expanded this issue beyond the title into live-process fingerprint policy and announce-path behavior.

options.title: Split Remaining Live-Fingerprint Work
options.body: Treat this issue as the group-intro/session-binding tracker and leave the `systemPromptHash` live-session restart work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81041 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81047.

options.title: Keep This As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Claude CLI prompt-drift umbrella until the open PR and all linked live-fingerprint variants are resolved.

options.title: Close After PR Cleanup
options.body: Once https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91157 is closed or superseded, close this issue as implemented-on-main and point remaining reports to the narrower live-session tracker.

recommendation.title: Split Remaining Live-Fingerprint Work
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the group-intro/session-binding tracker and leave the `systemPromptHash` live-session restart work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81041 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81047.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged structural soft-resume and session-stable prompt fixes that define the current direction.
